name: Trybe Summer Jobs and Paid Internships (East Oakland)
what_you_do: You can get skills building, leadership training and paid internships with Trybe, an East Bay youth program. The City's summer jobs list shows that Trybe offers a 100 hour summer job for East Oakland youth.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 24 on the 2026 flyer. 2027 rules are not posted. The 2022 posting said youth 16 and over with valid photo ID and a valid SSN or ITIN were paid; younger youth got a stipend. Confirm with the program.
pay_detail: City of Oakland's 2026 list says paid, 100 hours, at least Oakland minimum wage. Trybe's own 2022 posting said $15.06 per hour (old).
deadline_text: 2026 flyer: applications opened Apr 20, interviews May 18, internship June 10 to July 9, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Call (510) 985-9915 or email info@oaklandtrybe.org. Trybe also has a Jobs/Internships page on its site.
notes: Trybe's free summer camp is for kids 0 to 14; the paid youth internship is separate. The dates shown are from the 2026 flyer on the summer page, so they are last year's. The flyer lists food systems, community care, skilled trades and outdoor youth work. Call to ask about 2027. Do not confuse oaklandtrybe.org with trybe.org.
